summary: Qualification passed every deterministic and semantic case.

cases.title: Repair LangGraph Functional API runtime binding

requirementAssessments.evidence: The actor identifies the replacement of `removedSupportWorkflow` with the directly exported `supportWorkflow`. The diff confirms that exact replacement, while `src/workflow.ts` exports `supportWorkflow` and contains no `removedSupportWorkflow`; deterministic validation reports valid output with no failures.

Current `moldea/moldea.yaml` binds `/src/workflow.ts` to symbol `supportWorkflow`, exactly matching `export const supportWorkflow` in source. The approved diff shows only the one-line symbol repair, and deterministic validation and typechecking passed.

The source still defines `answerQuestion` with LangGraph `task()` and directly invokes it from the exported `entrypoint()`. The complete manifest contains only the runtime binding and `affectedBy`; it has no tool, skill, handoff, capability, or schema binding. Expected `moldea/tools`, `moldea/skills`, `moldea/handoffs`, and `moldea/schemas` paths are absent. Git status reports only `moldea/moldea.yaml`, and its diff changes only the runtime symbol.

cases.title: Preserve the LangGraph Functional API static boundary

requirementAssessments.evidence: `moldea/moldea.yaml` retains support’s `/src/support-workflow.ts#supportWorkflow` binding. `src/support-workflow.ts` still directly calls `lookupOrder`, uses `getPreviousState` and `interrupt`, and returns separate `value` and `save` fields through `entrypoint.final`. No executable schema relationship was added.

The unchanged TypeScript sources retain support input/saved-state/output types and dynamic-support input/result types. Both agents have an `executable-schema-contract` unresolved entry, the shared guide states TypeScript types do not establish executable schema bindings, and the manifest has no `schemas` declaration. Deterministic typecheck and validation passed.

`src/dynamic-support-workflow.ts` still selects tasks from `input.route`, calls through `runSelectedTask`, and invokes `summarize` inside a map callback. The manifest records dynamic task control flow and routing topology as unresolved, while the diff adds no routing targets, handoffs, subagents, or topology relationships.

The manifest contains no tool, skill, handoff, subagent, or capability declaration keys; targeted expected canonical paths for those declarations are absent. The only task references added are negative unresolved guidance stating that task definitions do not establish registered capabilities.

Both the manifest and `/moldea/runtimes/langgraph.md` explicitly require deployed configuration and runtime evidence for checkpointer persistence, replay, task idempotency, interrupt/resume safety, and approval policy. The patch does not claim these behaviors as statically proved.

Both agents set `runtime.guidance: /moldea/runtimes/langgraph.md`. A targeted runtime-guide listing contains only that Markdown file, and workspace assertions identify it as the sole new runtime-guidance path. Its three concise paragraphs cover lexical/code-shape observations, capability/schema/routing limits, and unresolved runtime semantics.
